title: Mara and the Bakery
author: Hazel Delacroix
blurb: Wren Joubert, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
